emailSubject: FMB News | 26 Dead, 5.1M Affected as Red Rainfall Alerts Batter Luzon | August 18, 2026 | 1:00 PM PHT
headline: OCD Brief Reports 26 Fatalities and 5.1 Million Affected as Red Rain Alerts Hit Luzon
seoTitle: OCD Brief: 26 Fatalities, 5.1M Affected | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News midday package reports 26 fatalities and 5.1 million affected as severe monsoon rainfall alerts continued across western Luzon.
deck: The cumulative disaster picture worsened as evacuation, rainfall and reservoir concerns remained active.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News midday package, citing the Office of Civil Defense and NDRRMC, reports 26 disaster fatalities and 5,114,300 affected individuals across 10 regions as of midday August 18.
The same package reports more than 62,000 displaced people in 545 evacuation centers and Red Rainfall Warnings over Bataan, Batangas and Zambales.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: These are cumulative disaster-response figures reported by the approved newsroom package. Affected population, displaced population and fatalities are different measures and should not be combined.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The figures help show the scale of the emergency and the pressure on evacuation, relief and local response systems.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch OCD and NDRRMC situation reports for validation of casualties, missing persons, displacement, damage and assistance totals.
